title: Unit Rates
topic: Unit rate as a comparison to 1 unit; better-buy comparisons

items.prompt: A car travels 240 miles in 4 hours. What is the unit rate in miles per hour?
A bag of 8 apples costs $4. What is the unit price per apple, in dollars?
A unit rate compares a quantity to:

choices.A: Another quantity of the same kind

items.rationale: A unit rate expresses a comparison per 1 unit (e.g., miles per 1 hour).

items.prompt: A runner covers 15 miles in 3 hours at a constant pace. How many miles does she cover in 1 hour?
Which is the better buy: 3 notebooks for $6, or 5 notebooks for $12?

choices.C: They cost the same per notebook

items.rationale: $6/3 = $2.00 per notebook vs. $12/5 = $2.40 per notebook, so 3 for $6 is the better unit price.
